choices: Both can appear equally determined from a distance.
Problems arise, however, when resilience ceases to describe an individual’s available resources and becomes a moral expectation imposed irrespective of circumstance.
Hesitation, intellectual wandering and even the decision to abandon a poorly chosen goal may then be interpreted as shortcomings.
The most defensible educational culture does not celebrate perseverance without qualification.
